headline: Approved contracts and purchases including $459,843 transit operations extension, $340,000 CBIZ audit contract, and $173,091.95 Toro mower purchase
summary: The Finance Committee approved a series of purchases and contracts including poll pads, auditing services, snow plowing, pavement management, playground equipment for two parks, police equipment, and a transit services contract extension. The committee also reviewed the FY25 audit results, confirmed compliance with expenditure records, and held a brief non-public session on emergency functions preparation.
decisions: Approved purchase of 27 KnowInk Poll Pads not to exceed $63,000
Approved two-year auditing contract with CBIZ CPAS, P.C. not to exceed $340,000 for FY26 and FY27
Approved contract with The Doty Group, Inc. for snow plowing services not to exceed $50,000
Approved engineering contract with Stantec Consulting Services, Inc. for pavement management not to exceed $43,700
Approved purchase of one 2026 Toro GM5910 Groundmaster Mower from Turf Products not to exceed $173,091.95
Approved purchase of a 2026 ABI Force Z23HLT infield groomer from Alta Equipment Company not to exceed $59,826.61
Approved purchase of new playground structure and equipment for Jeff Morin Park from Ultiplay Parks & Recreation not to exceed $153,483
Approved purchase of new playground structure and equipment for Los Amigos Park from Ultiplay Parks & Recreation not to exceed $145,000
Approved renewal HVAC maintenance contract with Trane US, Inc. for Nashua Police Department not to exceed $29,920
Approved purchase of ammunition with Eagle Point/TJ Morris & Son not to exceed $120,632
Approved purchase of department issue clothing with Mach V Group, LLC, dba East Coast Emergency Outfitters not to exceed $120,000
Approved purchase of Second Chance SX 02 Level II bulletproof vests with DCF Investigative Services not to exceed $36,996.75
Approved Contract Amendment #7 to the transit operations services contract with First Transit (Trans Dev) not to exceed $459,843
Confirmed compliance with City Charter and ordinances on the record of expenditures for June 12-25, 2026 and July 10-30, 2026
Voted 5-0 to go into non-public session under RSA 91-A:3 II(i) regarding emergency functions preparation
Voted 5-0 to keep the non-public session minutes confidential
